newsitems.title: Ride a sentient motorcycle-plane to make deliveries in Into the Wind
newsitems.contents: Into the Wind was not even remotely on my radar until now, but after seeing it during the Future Games Show I am convinced it's going to be great. Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2026/08/ride-a-sentient-motorcycle-plane-to-make-deliveries-in-into-the-wind/
